scrollOfInifuss.name: Scroll of Inifuss
scrollOfInifuss.description: Recovered at the Tree of Inifuss after clearing the Dark Wood. Give it to Akara in the Rogue Encampment; then return to the ruined-village cage to rescue Cain.

malahsPotion.name: Malah’s Potion
malahsPotion.description: Bound quest potion. Use it at frozen Anya in the Crystalline Passage. It cannot restore Life or Mana in combat.

scrollOfResistance.name: Scroll of Resistance
scrollOfResistance.description: Read once for permanent +{{allResist}}% fire, cold, lightning, poison, arcane and physical resistance. Claiming alone grants no resistance.

mephistosSoulstone.name: Mephisto’s Soulstone
mephistosSoulstone.description: A bound quest trophy granted by The Guardian. Consumed together with the Hellforge Hammer when shattering the Soulstone at the Hellforge. It cannot be read or equipped.

khalimsHeart.name: Khalim’s Heart
khalimsHeart.description: Recover it in the Flayer Jungle after clearing the area. Consumed when assembling Khalim’s Will.

khalimsBrain.name: Khalim’s Brain
khalimsBrain.description: Recover it in the Great Marsh after clearing the area. Consumed when assembling Khalim’s Will.

khalimsEye.name: Khalim’s Eye
khalimsEye.description: Recover it in the Kurast Bazaar after clearing the area. Consumed when assembling Khalim’s Will.

khalimsFlail.name: Khalim’s Flail
khalimsFlail.description: Defeat the High Council in Travincal, then recover the Flail explicitly. Consumed when assembling Khalim’s Will.

khalimsWill.name: Khalim’s Will
khalimsWill.description: Assemble from all four components using the retained Horadric Cube. Consumed when breaking the Compelling Orb in Travincal. Claim the quest reward separately.

jadeFigurine.name: Jade Figurine
jadeFigurine.description: Recover the figurine in the Spider Forest, then give it to Deckard Cain in Kurast Docks in exchange for the Golden Bird.

goldenBird.name: Golden Bird
goldenBird.description: Cain exchanged this bird for the Jade Figurine. Give it to Alkor in Kurast Docks.

potionOfLife.name: Potion of Life
potionOfLife.description: Read once for +{{maxLife}} permanent maximum Life. Current Life and XP do not change.

recovery.ready: Recover this previously claimed quest reward. This does not grant XP.

gidbinn.name: The Gidbinn
gidbinn.description: Recover this sacred blade in the Flayer Jungle, then give it to Ormus in Kurast Docks.

lam_esens_tome.name: Lam Esen’s Tome
lam_esens_tome.description: Recover this ancient tome in the Kurast Bazaar, then give it to Alkor in Kurast Docks.

hellforgeHammer.desc: Defeat Hephasto in the River of Flame while tracking Hell’s Forge, then recover this bound hammer. Shattering the Soulstone consumes both this hammer and Mephisto’s Soulstone. Claim the quest reward separately.

crafting.title: Crafting & sockets
crafting.progression: Rune fusion uses your highest unlocked act and selected difficulty: Act I–V caps are rune 8 / 15 / 19 / 21 / 33, with a maximum of 22 outside Hell. Gem fusion can exceed the gem drop cap.

rules.rune-fusion: Exchange three identical runes for the next rune. The output must be unlocked.
rules.gem-fusion: Exchange three identical subperfect gems and one gem-shard for the next quality.
rules.gem-dismantle: Destroy one gem to obtain gem-shards based on its quality.
rules.socket-insert: Select one unequipped backpack weapon or armor with an empty socket. Inserts fill the next socket in order. Exact rune order, base, slot and capacity determine a runeword; other combinations retain their plain socket effects.
rules.socket-armor: Select one normal chest item in your backpack with empty contents. Its socket capacity is rolled from 1 to the base maximum.
rules.socket-clear: Select one backpack weapon or armor with inserted materials. Clearing retains the item and socket capacity, and destroys every insert without a refund.
rules.caster-amulet: Select one identified magic amulet in your backpack with empty contents. It becomes rare with Energy +5, Mana +20 and one legal prefix and suffix.
rules.salvage: Select unequipped backpack or stash gear. Equipped, quest-bound and reserved Iron Golem items cannot be salvaged. Discarding items is a separate action and grants no materials.
rules.recover-v18: Select one preserved v18 item. Recovery places the same item in your backpack as normal gear with empty contents and refunds only its explicitly recorded runes. Older preserved gear remains inspect-only.

crafting.noWord: No completed runeword. Plain socket effects apply.
crafting.destroyGear: Selected equipment and all inserted materials will be permanently destroyed. Inserts are not refunded.
crafting.destroyInserts: Every inserted material and the completed runeword will be permanently removed. No inserts are refunded.
crafting.destroyGem: The selected gem will be permanently destroyed.
crafting.recoverNotice: The preserved runeword is removed. The same item ID, base, rolls, capacity and personalization are retained. Only the listed runes are refunded.
